municipality.title: About the municipality
municipality.description: Aydamoun Cheykhlar Municipality is a local government body that has served its citizens and developed the area since its founding. We are committed to providing the best municipal services and ensuring sustainable development for our community.
municipality.messageText: We are committed to delivering high-quality municipal services with transparency and efficiency, with a focus on community participation and sustainable development.
municipality.visionText: Building a safe, clean and thriving town whose citizens take part in decision-making.
municipality.villageDescription: Aydamoun is a Lebanese town in the Akkar district of North Lebanon, 700 meters above sea level, known for its green mountain landscape and peaceful atmosphere. Its people include both residents and members of the diaspora, and the town is known for its long history and natural beauty. Through its municipality, it works to strengthen local development and essential services for its people.
municipality.subtitle: Get to know the municipality and its council — one team working wholeheartedly for Aydamoun Cheykhlar and its people.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Aydamoun Cheykhlar Municipality respects the privacy of the users of its website and app and is committed to protecting the personal data that citizens provide. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use and protect it, and your rights regarding it.

collect.heading: Data we collect
body: Account data: full name, email and/or phone number, and password (stored encrypted; no one can view it).
Service request data: name, phone number, email, address, request description, and any additional information the service requires.
Limited technical data needed to run the website, such as login session cookies.

use.heading: How we use data
body: To process the municipal service requests submitted through the website, follow them up and update their status.
To contact you about your request when more information is needed or to inform you of the outcome.
To manage your account and let you log in and reset your password.
We do not use your data for advertising and we do not sell it to anyone.

share.heading: Data sharing
body: Your data is not shared with any third party except in the following cases: the municipal departments responsible for processing your request, or when required by law or a court order.
We use technical service providers to run the website (hosting, file storage and sending password reset emails); they process data on our behalf and only according to our instructions.

retention.heading: Data retention
body: We keep account data for as long as the account remains active.
Service requests are kept for as long as needed to process them and for administrative archiving in line with the municipality's procedures.
When you delete your account, your personal data and the requests linked to it are permanently deleted from the system.

rights.heading: Your rights
body: You can view and edit your data at any time from your profile page.
You can edit or delete the service requests you have submitted.
You can delete your entire account from your profile page, or write to us to request it.
For questions about your data or to file a complaint about how it is processed, please contact us using the information below.

security.heading: Data protection
body: Passwords are stored encrypted using secure hashing algorithms and cannot be recovered in their original form.
Data exchanged between your device and the website travels over an encrypted connection, and access to administrative data is limited to authorized staff.

cookies.heading: Cookies
body: We only use essential cookies to keep you logged in and to remember your display language. We do not use advertising tracking cookies.

children.heading: Children's privacy
body: Our services are intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect data from children under eighteen without the consent of a parent or guardian.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy as our services evolve or legal requirements change; the date of the last update will appear at the top of the page.

contact.heading: Contact us
body: For any question about privacy or your personal data, you can contact Aydamoun Cheykhlar Municipality:
Email: info@aydamoun-cheykhlar-municipality.org
Address: Aydamoun Cheykhlar Municipality, Lebanon

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Aydamoun Cheykhlar Municipality website and app. By using the website or creating an account, you agree to be bound by these terms.

acceptance.heading: Acceptance of terms
body: By using the website, you confirm that you have read, understood and accepted these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the website.

accounts.heading: Account and password
body: You can create an account with an email address or a phone number. You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide.
You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity on your account. Please notify us immediately if you suspect any unauthorized use.
The municipality may suspend or cancel any account used in breach of these terms.

acceptableUse.heading: Acceptable use
body: You may not use the website for any unlawful purpose or to harm the website or other users.
You may not submit false or impersonated information, or attempt unauthorized access to the municipality's systems or to other users' data.
You may not send offensive, defamatory or unlawful content.

submissions.heading: Service requests
body: Submitting a request through the website does not mean it is automatically approved; all requests are reviewed according to the municipality's established procedures and regulations.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information and documents you submit. Incorrect information may lead to the request being rejected.
You can edit or delete your request from your profile page as long as its status allows it.
Some transactions may require visiting the municipality in person to complete the procedure or pay fees.

content.heading: Content and intellectual property
body: All content published on the website, including news, documents and logos, belongs to Aydamoun Cheykhlar Municipality and may not be republished for commercial purposes without prior permission.
You may view and download official documents for personal or administrative use.

availability.heading: Service availability
body: We strive to keep the website available at all times, but it may be temporarily unavailable for maintenance or for technical reasons beyond our control, without any resulting obligation.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
body: Information published on the website is provided for informational purposes. Although we strive for accuracy, the municipality is not liable for any damage resulting from reliance on outdated information.
In case of conflict between the website's content and the official regulations in force, the official regulations prevail.

termination.heading: Account termination
body: You can delete your account at any time from your profile page. Deletion permanently removes your data and requests.
The municipality may terminate or suspend an account that breaches these terms.

law.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws in force in Lebanon, and the competent Lebanese courts have jurisdiction over any dispute.

changes.heading: Changes to the terms
body: These terms may be amended from time to time; changes take effect from the date they are published on this page. Continuing to use the website after a change means you accept it.

contact.heading: Contact us
body: For any question about these terms, you can contact Aydamoun Cheykhlar Municipality:
Email: info@aydamoun-cheykhlar-municipality.org
Address: Aydamoun Cheykhlar Municipality, Lebanon
